product_example: Dumpling, gyoza, wonton, bao, spring roll with pasta wrapper
rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading except that of the product, in which non-originating materials of headings 1006 and 1101 to 1108 are at most 20% of product weight; chapters 2, 3 and 16 at most 20%; chapter 4 at most 20%; sugar at most 40%; sugar plus chapter 4 at most 50%
tolerance: General tolerance may not be used to exceed these caps (Article 5(4))
imported_chinese_textured_soy: No effect: textured soy (2106.10) is another heading and is not capped
imported_wheat_flour_or_gluten: Flour, starch or rice that is non-originating counts toward the 20% cap; flour milled in Viet Nam from imported wheat is non-originating (ORR-03); wheat gluten (1109) is not capped; Vietnamese rice flour and cassava starch are originating
meat_or_seafood_filling: Non-originating meat, fish or shrimp above 20% of weight breaks origin; Vietnamese farmed pork and shrimp are wholly obtained
notes: Note 3.5: non-originating cereals of chapter 10 milled in the same production are not limited by the 20% cap; flour bought from a mill is.

product_example: Chay food preparation (vegetarian meat analogue), seasoned textured soy pieces
rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading except that of the product; chapter 4 at most 20% of weight; sugar at most 40%; combined at most 50%
tolerance: Non-originating materials of the same heading may be used up to 10% of the weight of the product or ex-works price (Article 5(3)(a))
imported_chinese_textured_soy: Counts, because textured soy is also heading 2106. Passes if at most 10% of product weight, or on our reading of the text at most 10% of ex-works price (about 32 to 46% of weight at USD 4.27 to 5.87 per kg). Seasoning imported textured soy (2106.10 to 2106.10) never confers origin
imported_wheat_flour_or_gluten: Wheat gluten (1109), soy isolate (3504) and soy flour (1208) are other headings: allowed without limit
meat_or_seafood_filling: Not relevant to 2106 (meat preparations are chapter 16)
binds_on_domestic_textured_soy: Only for 2106.90 products above 10% imported dry textured soy by weight if the value option is not accepted, and for dry textured products made from imported textured soy or concentrate
notes: Value of materials is the customs value at import (Article 1(o)); Chinese textured soy CIF about USD 1.27 to 1.34 per kg (our calculation from TIC-12).

product_example: Wheat flour and gluten made in Viet Nam
rule: All materials of chapters 10 and 11 (and 0701, 0714.10, 2303, 0710.10) used must be wholly obtained
tolerance: Tolerance applies to the sum of such materials (Article 5(5))
imported_wheat_flour_or_gluten: Flour or gluten from imported wheat is non-originating; flour from Vietnamese rice and starch from Vietnamese cassava are originating

product_example: Spring roll with more than 20% pork if not classed as stuffed pasta
rule: All materials of chapters 2, 3 and 16 used must be wholly obtained
tolerance: 10% of weight or ex-works price for the sum of such materials
meat_or_seafood_filling: Meat must be Vietnamese-raised; entry of meat products also needs EU listing, which Viet Nam lacks (ORG-10)

product_example: Vegetable spring roll or vegetable mix classed as prepared vegetables
rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading except that of the product; sugar at most 20% of weight
notes: Classification of a given spring roll (1902, 1602, 2004, 2005 or 2106) decides which rule applies.

hs_line: 2106.10 made in Viet Nam from 1208 or 2304
rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading except that of the product
imported_chinese_textured_soy: Domestic textured soy extruded from imported defatted soy flour (1208) or meal (2304) is originating; extruded from imported concentrate (2106.10) it is not
binds_on_domestic_textured_soy: Design condition for T1, not a demand
notes: Soy flour milled in Viet Nam from imported soybeans is also originating (chapter 12: change of heading).

rule: Identical to EVFTA (UK-Viet Nam Origin Reference Document v1.1, Article 5 and Annex II)

notes: UK exporters can instead claim UK-CPTPP (ORR-08, ORR-09).

tolerance: 10% of value (UK CPTPP ORD tolerance article)
imported_wheat_flour_or_gluten: Allowed; flour milled in Viet Nam from imported wheat is originating
notes: Read from the UK CPTPP Origin Reference Document; CPTPP product-specific rules are common to members.

markets_served: United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, Australia, other members
product_example: Textured soy; chay food preparation; pork preparation
rule: 2106.10: change from any other subheading. 2106.90 (other goods): change from any other subheading, or regional value content of 30% (build-up) or 40% (build-down). 1602.41 to 1602.50: change from any other chapter except chapter 2, or 45% (build-down)
imported_chinese_textured_soy: 2106.10 to 2106.90 is a change of subheading: allowed. Textured soy made from imported concentrate (2106.10 to 2106.10) fails
meat_or_seafood_filling: Pork preparations from imported pork need 45% regional value content

markets_served: Japan, Korea, China, Australia, New Zealand, ASEAN
rule: 1101 CC; 1602 CC; 1902 CC; 1905 CTH or RVC40; 2106.10 CC or RVC40; 2106.90 CTH or RVC40
imported_chinese_textured_soy: 1902: allowed. 2106.90: needs 40% regional value content if more than the de minimis
notes: CC = change of chapter; CTH = change of heading; RVC40 = regional value content of 40%.

rule: Most-favoured-nation duty applies whatever the recipe
notes: Section 301 surcharge of 12.5% on Vietnamese goods since 24 Jul 2026 (MA-15) applies whatever the recipe.
